title: Package Manifest
description: A list of Debian packages, each with the reason it earns a slot. Read by the HomelabIaC image build and by config management.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. The validator fetches it.

packages.description: The packages. Names must be unique within a manifest; the HomelabIaC validator enforces that, since JSON Schema can't.

why.description: What the package is for, or why it is removed, in one line.

state.description: present installs the package; absent removes it. Dropping an entry leaves the package installed.

pin.description: Holds the package at one version through every upgrade, by an apt preferences entry plus name=version.

reason.description: Why the package can't move, in one line.

review_by.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the pin is reviewed.
